headline: Ukrainian Freediver Zharkova Wins World Championship Gold
captionCards: Zharkova wins gold with record-deep dive
New depth record set at world championship
instagramCaption:
A Ukrainian freediver claimed the top prize at a world championship.

Zharkova secured the gold medal by executing a record-deep dive during the competition. This performance established a new benchmark for depth in the sport.
The victory highlights elite human endurance and technical precision in competitive freediving.
